geographic_limitation: PH-filtered sources; row-level country and field context are not independently verified

provisional_candidate_summary.purpose: Assistant-screened field-photo candidate list; pending qualified label/provenance review and not approved for training
provisional_candidate_summary.rule: Retain one iNaturalist-first representative per recomputed near-duplicate group, unless the group contains a preliminary visual/context hold. Candidate photos look field-like but species and geography are not independently verified.

review_instructions: Open the species contact sheets and enter field_photo, specimen, unclear, or unreadable in human_visual_review.
Enter confirmed, incorrect, or uncertain in human_label_review only when qualified evidence is available.
Source keyword flags are prompts for review, not automatic exclusions or label changes.
Do not use the old test split as a fresh blind test; its performance has already been inspected.
